name: Catoc

attributes.attribute: sixth-century Welsh saint and founder of Llancarfan

text: Catoc, also written Catog, is a variant form of the name Cadog. Cadog ranks among the most honoured Welsh saints of the sixth century. He founded the monastery of Llancarfan in Glamorganshire. He planted roughly twenty further churches across south Wales. Invaders killed him around the year 577.

okr.objective: Catoc is a variant spelling of Cadog, the celebrated sixth-century Welsh saint.
